# GrabCAD

> GrabCAD is a Stratasys-integrated additive manufacturing platform enabling 3D printing at scale with software, IoT connectivity, and a global community of engineers.

GrabCAD provides enterprise-grade 3D printing software solutions including Print, Print Pro, and Streamline Pro, complemented by a community library of millions of CAD designs, engineering challenges, and discussion forums. The platform integrates with Stratasys printers and offers IoT-based fleet management and predictive maintenance capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Additive Manufacturing
- 3D Printing Software

## Core Software Products

- [GrabCAD Making Additive Manufacturing at Scale Possible](https://grabcad.com): GrabCAD homepage: Stratasys-integrated additive manufacturing platform
- [GrabCAD Print Software: Solution for Additive Manufacturing](https://grabcad.com/print): GrabCAD Print: 3D printing software with workflow optimization features
- [GrabCAD Print Pro Software: Advanced manufacturing control](https://grabcad.com/print/pro): GrabCAD Print Pro: Production-grade control with fixturemate integration
- [GrabCAD Streamline Pro](https://grabcad.com/streamline-pro): GrabCAD Streamline Pro: Enterprise workgroup software suite for 3D printing
- [GrabCAD Control](https://grabcad.com/control): GrabCAD Control: Cloud-based Stratasys printer fleet management solution

## Manufacturing Intelligence & Integration

- [GrabCAD IoT Platform](https://grabcad.com/iot): GrabCAD IoT Platform: Connected manufacturing with predictive maintenance
- [GrabCAD Software Development Kit](https://grabcad.com/software-development-kit): GrabCAD SDKs for Stratasys API integration and printer connectivity

- [fixturemate by trinckle: Design Custom Fixtures in Minutes](https://grabcad.com/print/pro/fixturemate): fixturemate: No-CAD fixture design tool integrated with GrabCAD Print Pro
